faqs.q: Does Myntmore have a separate office in Gurugram?
faqs.a: Our headquarters is in BKC, Mumbai, and we serve BFSI and fintech clients across Gurugram and Delhi NCR remotely with weekly strategy syncs, shared Slack/WhatsApp channels, and live pipeline reporting.

faqs.q: Can you run multi-stakeholder ABM into Indian banks and NBFCs?
faqs.a: Yes. We map multiple roles inside each target institution (such as CFO, CTO, Head of Digital, and Compliance) and tailor each message to that role's priorities.

faqs.q: How do you ensure outbound copy complies with financial-sector sensitivities?
faqs.a: We never make performance promises or unverified claims. Every email and LinkedIn sequence is approved by your leadership or compliance team before launch.

faqs.q: Can you target enterprise borrowers or corporate clients across all of India?
faqs.a: Yes. Whether you want meetings strictly in Gurugram and Delhi NCR or across India's top corporate hubs, we segment lists by region, turnover, and industry.

faqs.q: How quickly do BFSI outbound campaigns generate qualified meetings?
faqs.a: Infrastructure, verification, and messaging take 2 weeks. Initial executive replies and booked discovery calls typically start in weeks 3 to 5.
